basic_info.description: Exquisitely Remodeled Gem in Bayview! Step into this beautifully renovated home, designed with a modern, open floor plan and adorned with elegant, designer touches throughout. The welcoming entryway leads to the meticulously redesigned upper level, showcasing stunning wood floors that add warmth and sophistication. The Upper Level contains Two Spacious Bedrooms, perfect for relaxation and comfort. The Gourmet Kitchen is outfitted with top-of-the-line appliances for the culinary enthusiast with 2 ovens, convection Microwave and wine fridge.    Living/Dining Area is bathed in natural light, offering serene views of the garden, patio, and backyard that expands your entertaining options and a bonus Dog Run.  The  Laundry Area is discreetly located for ease of access. Lower Level Retreat:  Luxurious Primary Bedroom features a  generous walk-in closet and direct access to the garden/patio.    Spa-Like Bathroom is elegantly remodeled with double sinks and high-end finishes for a truly indulgent experience.    Additional amenities include an attached garage with interior access and ample storage space, enhancing the convenience of this exceptional home.    Ideally situated in the vibrant Bayview district, you'll enjoy close proximity to the Third Street T-line and Highway 101/280
